root_cause.text: Missing bounds checks on `ie_length` before subtracting fixed IE offsets, allowing unsigned integer underflow that can cause out-of-bounds reads or incorrect behavior.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds checks such as `if (pnetwork->network.ie_length < _FIXED_IE_LENGTH_) return false;` and `if (pnetwork->network.ie_length < _BEACON_IE_OFFSET_) { bselected = false; } else { ... }` to prevent subtraction that would otherwise underflow when `ie_length` is smaller than the offset.
